runners_data.name: Miraculous

races.paceDynamic: Station X will lead from the gates with Havana Rum likely to press or sit close second, creating a sustainable early tempo over this 6f trip. The majority of this field are hold-up horses (Bolo Neighs, Baldomero, Brummell, Accrual, Smart Vision, Miraculous, Tough Enough, Ran Amok) who will settle in midfield and beyond, meaning the early leaders won't face pressure. This setup creates a classic front-runner's dream where Station X can dictate fractions and kick clear, while the massed ranks of hold-up horses will need the pace to collapse to be effective. The race shape strongly favours the early pace-setters and prominent racers.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Station X Wires Field
scenarios.trigger: If Station X breaks cleanly and faces no early pressure from the hold-up majority
scenarios.body: The Bryan Smart runner can control the tempo completely and kick clear in the final furlong as the back markers struggle to make up ground. This tactical advantage combined with recent good form makes him extremely dangerous.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If Station X sets too strong a pace trying to get away from the field early
scenarios.body: The sustainable gallop becomes unsustainable and the hold-up brigade get their perfect scenario with a collapsing leader. The class horses at the rear can unleash their finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Havana Rum Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Havana Rum travels better than Station X and can sit closer to the pace
scenarios.body: The Fahey runner can use his prominent style to better effect, taking over from a weakening Station X and holding off the late closers. His recent form suggests he's ready to strike.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Ambush
scenarios.trigger: If the pace completely collapses and one of the bigger-priced hold-up horses finds significant improvement
scenarios.body: A horse like Tough Enough or Ran Amok could exploit the tactical scenario at rewarding odds. The going and distance dynamics might suit an improver perfectly.

watchPoints.text: Station X breaking cleanly is crucial - if he misses the break, the entire pace dynamic shifts and favors the hold-up horses significantly.
Monitor the early tempo set by Station X - if he goes too fast trying to shake off the field, it plays into the hands of Bolo Neighs and Brummell.
Havana Rum's position turning for home will be telling - if he's traveling well within striking distance, he becomes the main danger.
Check how aggressively the hold-up horses are ridden early - any that break from character could disrupt the expected pace scenario.
Watch for Bolo Neighs finding racing room in the final furlong given his hold-up style and the congestion that may develop.

races.paceDynamic: With Postmodern declared a non-runner, this removes the confirmed front runner and creates a pace scramble among multiple prominent racers. Sir Albert, Masked Warrior, Startled, and Proud Nation all show early pace, likely creating a moderate to strong gallop over Chester's unique circuit. The combination of good to soft ground and 7½ furlongs around Chester's tight turns will test stamina reserves in the final furlong. This pace setup and track configuration strongly favours hold-up horses who can finish late, with the prominent racers likely to pay for early exertions.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominant
scenarios.trigger: If multiple prominent runners engage early and create genuine pace pressure
scenarios.body: The pace collapses in Chester's demanding final furlong as the early leaders tire on testing ground. Do Bronxs and Just A Girl, both natural hold-up performers, sweep past the weakening pace-setters with superior finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Tactical Scramble Benefits Class
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes messy with no clear leader through the early stages
scenarios.body: Sir Albert's class advantage tells as he can dictate from the front in a slowly-run affair. His superior rating and P J McDonald's tactical nous prove decisive when others struggle to find racing room around Chester's turns.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one prominent runner gets an uncontested lead and controls the tempo
scenarios.body: Startled or Masked Warrior steal a march by leading unchallenged, maintaining enough energy reserves for Chester's climb to the line. The lack of early pace pressure allows them to sustain their effort where others cannot respond.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Benefits From Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is extremely strong and all fancied runners are compromised
scenarios.body: The race becomes a war of attrition where form lines become irrelevant and a lesser-rated runner like Jeddaal sneaks through. Ashley Lewis's 5lb claim becomes crucial in a slowly-finishing contest where every pound matters.

watchPoints.text: Monitor the early pace battle between Sir Albert, Startled, and Masked Warrior as any prolonged duel will set up the hold-up horses perfectly
Watch Do Bronxs's position turning into the straight as he needs clear racing room to unleash his finishing kick around Chester's tight bends
Observe how Penny Time handles the return from his 59-day break as fitness doubts could undermine his otherwise strong claims
Check if Just A Girl can secure the ideal tracking position behind the early pace without getting shuffled back in the competitive field
Note whether Comic Hero shows any ring-rustiness early given his 43-day absence and need to be sharp from the outset at this track

races.paceDynamic: Ultrasoul will take this along at a comfortable gallop from the front, with Pride Of Donegal, Rastnet and Impartiality tracking in behind on what looks a sustainable pace. The lack of natural speed in this field means no serious pressure on the leader through the early stages, allowing the race to develop into a tactical affair. With plenty of hold-up horses including Savvy Victory, Lexington Jet, Naval Command and Golden West needing to be produced late, the moderate early pace will suit prominent racers and those with tactical speed who can position handy and kick when it matters.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Drive Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Ultrasoul maintains a strong gallop turning for home and the pace doesn't collapse completely.
scenarios.body: The sustained tempo will stretch out the field and favor horses with stamina who can grind out the finish. Those tracking the pace in good position will have the advantage over horses coming from too far back.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Dash Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is too slow and the race becomes a sprint from the two-furlong pole.
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace allows the hold-up horses to close the gap and their superior class tells in a driving finish. Fresh legs and a strong turn of foot become crucial.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Holds On
scenarios.trigger: If Ultrasoul gets an easy lead and quickens clear approaching the final furlong.
scenarios.body: The combination of a soft lead and tactical acceleration proves too much for the closers on this testing ground. Class and stamina from the front end wins the day.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If no horse wants to go on and the pace becomes crawling throughout.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a complete lottery with the field bunched turning in, favoring those drawn well and with the most natural speed. Positioning and luck in running become everything.

watchPoints.text: Ultrasoul faces a significant fitness test after 248 days off and may not see out the trip if pressed hard.
Golden West has been absent for 639 days which makes any assessment of current ability almost impossible.
The pace could collapse completely if Ultrasoul doesn't go forward, turning this into a tactical crawl.
Several hold-up horses including Savvy Victory and Lexington Jet need a strong pace that may not materialize.
Pride Of Donegal and Rastnet are best positioned to track the likely leader and have first run on the closers.

races.paceDynamic: Atomic Force is the sole confirmed front runner and will dictate proceedings from the gate in this 5f sprint. With six prominent runners (Ruby's Profit, Rosenpur, Al Hussar, Copper Knight, Tricky Tel) likely pressing behind, the early pace should be steady but not fierce. The four hold-up horses (Vintage Clarets, Changeofmind, Marty Hopkirk, Blinky) will need the pace to be genuine to get competitive. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can track Atomic Force and strike in the final furlong when the lone leader tires.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent pack settles nicely behind Atomic Force and delivers their challenge at the right moment.
scenarios.body: The measured early pace allows Al Hussar, Rosenpur, and Ruby's Profit to position perfectly and overwhelm the tiring leader. Hold-up horses find themselves too far back when the race develops.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Leader Stays Strong
scenarios.trigger: If Atomic Force maintains his kick and the prominent runners fail to coordinate their challenge.
scenarios.body: The 7-year-old's fitness edge shows as he repels late challenges, with only the best-positioned prominent runner getting close. His recent Chester form proves decisive.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Success
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes genuinely strong with the prominent pack pressing Atomic Force too hard.
scenarios.body: The speed duel up front opens the door for Vintage Clarets and Changeofmind to come from off the pace. Both have winning form on similar ground and benefit from the collapse ahead.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Atomic Force goes too slow and the prominent runners hesitate to take over.
scenarios.body: The sprint becomes a cavalry charge with positioning crucial and any horse getting a clear run capable of winning. The race becomes a lottery with form going out the window.

watchPoints.text: Atomic Force could steal this if he dictates a slow pace and kicks clear before prominent runners react
Al Hussar's position behind the leader is crucial - if trapped he'll struggle despite his good form
Ruby's Profit needs to overcome his recent inconsistency to fulfill the promise of his handicap mark
Changeofmind requires the prominent pack to go hard early to bring his staying power into play
Track Vintage Clarets' position turning in - his hold-up style needs clear running room in the straight

races.paceDynamic: Savrola will likely lead from the start with his prominent style and recent winning form, setting what should be a manageable pace over this 2m trip. The prominent brigade of It's All About You, Solar Pass, Heathen, Pergamon and Action Pact will track close behind, creating a solid tempo but nothing extreme given Chester's tight turns. The hold-up horses Fox Journey, Barenboim, Dino Bellagio and Cascade Hall face a significant tactical disadvantage on this sharp track where getting cover and room late can prove problematic. This pace shape strongly favours prominent racers who can track the early pace and kick from ideal positions turning for home.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent horses settle nicely behind Savrola's controlled lead
scenarios.body: The tactical advantage becomes decisive as they can quicken from ideal positions while hold-up horses struggle for racing room on Chester's tight circuit. Solar Pass and It's All About You are perfectly positioned to capitalize with their recent good form.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes genuinely strong and the prominent horses over-race
scenarios.body: Fox Journey and Dino Bellagio can use their hold-up styles to sweep past tired leaders in the final furlong. The faster early fractions would set up their patient tactics perfectly.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Benefits Leaders
scenarios.trigger: If Savrola gets an uncontested lead and the prominent horses fail to pressure
scenarios.body: The leader can dictate terms completely and prove difficult to peg back despite his recent poor run at Haydock. Action Pact's light weight could help him stay closest to the untroubled pacesetter.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Longshot Breaks Through
scenarios.trigger: If the market leaders fail to handle the going conditions or trip
scenarios.body: Pergamon's dual course wins or Cascade Hall's recent victory could prove significant factors. Their lower ratings might not reflect their actual chances in these specific conditions.

watchPoints.text: Savrola could get an uncontested lead if the prominent horses are slow to engage early

Kingdom Of Stars and Pergamon both return from very long breaks with fitness questions

races.paceDynamic: Wiltshire Wonder will take them along from the front with minimal pressure, as the only confirmed front runner in this field. This sets up a controlled tempo that will gradually build through the middle stages before a sustained drive up Chester's testing climb. The lack of early pace pressure strongly favours hold-up horses who can finish off what should be a moderate gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Pace Suits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Wiltshire Wonder leads unchallenged and the pace stays moderate through halfway
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get perfect conditions to unleash late kicks up Chester's demanding hill. Spirit Of Acklam and Free Speech can time their runs to perfection from off the pace.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Wiltshire Wonder goes too slow and the race becomes a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace creates chaos in the straight with traffic problems. Any horse getting a clear run can win, favouring those with tactical speed.

watchPoints.text: Spirit Of Acklam could be overbet given his hold-up style perfectly suits the likely controlled pace scenario
Wiltshire Wonder's 250-day absence is a major unknown despite getting likely uncontested lead
